title: Santander midata CSV is refused: 'Merchant/Description' and 'Debit/Credit' headers are not recognised
detail: The midata export's header 'Date,Type,Merchant/Description,Debit/Credit,Balance' maps only Date; GUESS has no pattern for 'Merchant/Description' (payee) or 'Debit/Credit' (signed amount), so read() fails with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount.' before the user ever reaches the column mapper, even though the mapper could have fixed it by hand. Reproduced through KOS.money.csv.parse/guess on money-samples/midata-comma.csv: mapping {date:0}, dialogAccepts false.
evidence: js/core/money.js:970-977 (GUESS), js/modules/money.js:937-940 (hard refusal before the mapper); repro: scratchpad/qa/money-samples/midata-comma.csv, scratchpad/qa/mg-import.js
fix: Add patterns (merchant/description, debit/credit, 'amount (£)', 'money in/out (£)'); and never hard-fail on unguessed headers: open the Columns step with the unmatched columns and let the user map them.
rootCause: Exact-match header regexes plus a hard gate before the manual mapper.

title: Import only reads the first line as the header: midata with a leading blank line or a semicolon delimiter, and Online Banking CSV with an account preamble, all fail
detail: parseCSV picks the delimiter from line 1 only (a leading blank line forces ','), and takes rows[0] as the header. Santander midata variants (';' delimited, trailing ';', blank first line) parse into one column; the Online Banking CSV/Excel export starts with 'Account:'/'From:' preamble lines so the header is 'Account:,Santander…'. All refused with the same generic message.
evidence: js/core/money.js:947-969; browser repro of 6 sample files (midata-semicolon.csv delimiter ',' header one cell; santander-online-excel.csv header ['Account:',…]); all dialogAccepts=false
fix: Detect the delimiter over the first ~10 non-empty lines; scan the first 20 rows for the first row that matches date+amount header patterns and treat everything above as preamble (show it as 'Skipped: 3 header lines'); drop trailing empty columns.
rootCause: Header = rows[0], delimiter sniffed from text.split(/\r?\n/)[0].

title: Santander's other exports (.txt, QIF, OFX) are not supported at all; the picker accepts .txt but cannot read it
detail: Online Banking 'Download transactions' offers text (Date:/Description:/Amount:/Balance: blocks with non-breaking spaces), Excel CSV, Quicken QIF and Microsoft Money OFX. The importer is CSV-only, yet the file input accepts text/plain, so the user's .txt is taken and fails with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount.' OFX would also give a stable FITID for exact de-duplication.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:889 (accept .csv,text/csv,text/plain), js/core/money.js:947; repro: money-samples/santander-online.txt, santander.qif, santander.ofx all refused
fix: Add format sniffing: OFX/QFX (parse STMTTRN, use FITID as the dedupe key, LEDGERBAL to reconcile), QIF (D/T/P/M/^ records), the Santander .txt block format; name the format detected in the Columns step. Keep CSV for everything else.
rootCause: Single CSV parser path.

title: Duplicate transactions after re-importing: de-dupe key includes payee, so a second import mapped differently is all 'new'
detail: Exactly the user's screenshot: the same Heron Foods row twice, once titled with the payee and once titled 'Other' with the bank text as the subtitle. Reproduced: import a statement with Description->Payee, then the same file with Description->Note (or payee unmapped); preview reports 0 duplicates and every row imports again. The key is date|minor|payee.lower(), and an empty payee never equals the first import's payee. The second row reads 'Other' because txRow falls back to the category name when payee is empty and shows the note as the sub-line.
evidence: js/core/money.js:1025-1031 (key), js/modules/money.js:587,591 (title/subtitle fallback); shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png; eval repro: second preview {dups:0}
fix: Key duplicates on date+amount+kind+normalised bank text (payee OR note OR raw description, stored as tx.raw), with the bank's own id (OFX FITID / balance-chain) when present; keep the raw description on every imported row; offer 'Replace the previous import of this period' in the preview when a batch overlaps.
rootCause: Dedupe depends on user-chosen mapping; raw source text not kept.

title: No way to see, undo or replace an import after the result dialog closes
detail: Each import has a batch id, but 'Undo this import' exists only on the Done step of the dialog (money.js:915). Once closed there is no import history, no filter by source/batch in Transactions (list() filters kind/cat/tag/search only), and bulk select has no 'select all' over a range, so removing a bad 200-row import means ticking rows one by one.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:915-917; js/core/money.js:1050-1056 (undoBatch only caller), list() keep() js/core/money.js:~700-712
fix: An 'Imports' list (Transactions › Imports or Settings): file name, date range, rows, when imported, with Undo/Delete and 'Replace with a new file'. Store {batch, fileName, from, to, n, at} in state.money.imports. Add a Source filter and Select all in view.
rootCause: Batch metadata is not stored anywhere but on rows; UI only exposes it in a transient dialog.

title: Unquoted thousands separators shift columns: '£1,234.56' imports silently as £1.00
detail: A comma-delimited bank file that writes amounts like £1,234.56 without quotes (common in hand-rolled UK exports, and what users get after re-saving midata in a text editor) splits the amount into two cells. The parser never checks a row's cell count against the header, so the Student Finance row imported as +£1.00 and the balance column swallowed '234.56'. No warning in the preview.
evidence: js/core/money.js:947-969 (no per-row width check), 1005-1013; eval repro: row ['2026-10-27','in',100,'STUDENT FINANCE ENGLAND SLC']; shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png shows +£1.00
fix: Flag rows whose cell count differs from the header ('Row 3 has 6 cells, the header has 5'), and for the known Santander layout re-join a split £n,nnn.nn amount; show the running Balance column so a mismatch is visible.
rootCause: Parser trusts column positions without validating row width.

title: A recurring rule's 'Confirm' and an imported bank row for the same payment double-count
detail: Confirming an occurrence (Google One £1.59, Phone £10) writes its own transaction r:<rule>:<date> with payee = rule name; importing the bank statement then adds 'GOOGLE *Google One, ON 27-10-2026' £1.59 as a separate row. Neither side looks at the other: preview's dedupe compares payee text ('google one' vs the bank string) and confirm() never searches existing transactions. Spend, budgets, Safe to spend and Reports count the payment twice. This is a second path to the duplicates the user saw.
evidence: js/core/money.js:414-433 (confirm creates tx unconditionally), 1025-1031 (dedupe by exact payee); recurring page shows Google One 'Due' for Sep/Oct even though the user has bank rows for them (shots/money-goals/recurring-mac.png)
fix: On import, match rows to due occurrences (same amount ±0, date within ±3 days, payee alias set on the rule) and MARK the occurrence done pointing at the imported tx instead of creating a new one; on Confirm, offer 'Use the bank entry from 27 Oct' when one matches.
rootCause: Rules and imports are two independent writers of the same real-world payment.

title: Imported rows are unusable as information: raw bank strings, everything in Other, Type and Balance columns discarded
detail: Every imported row lands in Other/Other income (preview opts.outCat), payee is the raw bank text ('HERON FOODS HOYLAND (VIA APPLE PAY), ON 29-10-2026', 'CARD PAYMENT TO …,3.45 GBP, RATE 1.00/GBP ON …'), so Overview's 'This month by category' is one 'Other' bar, the Selected card shows a 4-line shouting title, spend-by-merchant is impossible and nothing learns from the user's re-categorising. The bank's Type (DEB/DD/FPI/FPO/SO) and Balance columns are dropped, so direct debits are not detected and the import cannot be reconciled. There is no merchant normalisation, no payee->category memory and no recurring detection anywhere in money.js.
evidence: js/core/money.js:1019-1021 (cat = other), 1041; grep of money.js/modules/money.js finds no merchant/auto-category code; shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png
fix: Revamp (see summary): store raw text, derive a clean merchant (strip 'CARD PAYMENT TO', '(VIA APPLE PAY)', ', ON dd-mm-yyyy', ',n.nn GBP, RATE …', store numbers, title-case); payee rules {match -> merchant, category} learned when the user sets a category ('Always put Heron Foods in Food?'); a built-in UK merchant table (Tesco, Heron Foods, Greggs, Stagecoach, Google, Spotify, SLC…); Type DD/SO -> suggest a recurring rule; Balance -> reconcile and show 'Matches the bank: £120.10'.
rootCause: Import engine was built as a column copier ('the pages are phase 2' comment at money.js:946).

title: Month and year: 'In' shows expected income as if received
detail: For the current month the side card's In figure is ins.planned (received + still expected), e.g. 'IN £450.00 · £450.00 still expected' when nothing has come in yet. The headline figure should be what came in, with expected as the sub-line.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1695-1697; shots/money-goals/month-mac.png
fix: fig('In', cur.income, expected ? '+' + said(expected) + ' still expected' : null).
rootCause: inFig uses ins.planned

title: 'Never printed' card shows designer rules to the user
detail: Month and year's side column contains a card titled 'Never printed' explaining 'Never a bare 0 or +∞%' — an implementation rule from the design notes, meaningless to the user and violating invariant 50a (rules belong in Help & Guide).
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1698; shots/money-goals/month-mac.png
fix: Remove the card; use the column for something useful (top merchants this month, biggest change, the month's subscriptions).
rootCause: Design annotation shipped as UI copy.

title: Money's section tabs jump between pages (Add entry button appears on some pages only)
detail: On Overview/Transactions/Recurring the tab strip spans x≈617–1180 with '+ Add entry' after it; on Budgets/Pots/Month and year there is no Add entry and the strip sits at x≈742–1305 and vertically centred differently (y 183 vs 204). Switching tabs makes the control you just clicked move under the pointer. The strip and Hide amounts pill also sit over the painted header band, Hide amounts touching its right edge on Budgets/Pots.
evidence: shots/money-goals/overview-mac.png vs budgets-mac.png, pots-mac.png, month-mac.png
fix: Keep Add entry (or a placeholder of equal width) on every Money page, or put the section tabs on their own row left-aligned under the title as other Productivity pages do.
rootCause: header() actions differ per view in js/modules/money.js

title: Pots: empty right column beside the pot cards, and Move money's tabs/select clipped
detail: With two pots the grid shows Emergency and the 'Saving for something?' tile, leaving a ~410px empty column on the right (x 1036–1446). The Move money card clips 'Between pots' at its right edge and the To select shows 'New laptop fc'.
evidence: shots/money-goals/pots-mac.png
fix: Use auto-fill grid with minmax so cards stretch (or put Move money in the empty column); let the Move money segments wrap and put From/To on separate rows under ~360px.
rootCause: Fixed-column pot grid; segmented control without wrap.

title: iPhone Recurring: the third occurrence tile is cut off at the card edge
detail: At 402px each due rule shows three occurrence tiles in a row; the third (Sat 28 Nov · Upcoming) runs to x=410, past the card and viewport, reading "Upcomi" / "Sat 28 No". It is not a declared scroller (invariant 50). The New rule form is also always expanded at the bottom of the phone page and the + FAB covers its Next-dates line.
evidence: DOM measure iphone #/money/recurring: k-mn-occ-i right=410; shots/money-goals/recurring-iphone.png
fix: Under 560px show two tiles (last + next) or wrap them; make the tile row a KOS.ui.scroller if three are needed; collapse New rule behind the + New rule button on phone.
rootCause: Fixed 3-column occurrence grid without a phone tier

title: iPhone: Money's Transactions, Month and year, Import/Export CSV and Goals' This week/This month/Done are unreachable
detail: Under 700px the page's section tabs ([data-phone-tabs]) are hidden on the promise that the title bar's switch offers them, but mobile-shell's destinations() only falls back to page tabs when the section has no subnav. Productivity has a subnav, so the 'Switch within Productivity' sheet lists Focus Timer…Money, Goals, and Money's six views and Goals' four views vanish. On the Money overview the only visible links are Budgets →, Recurring →, Pots →; there is no way to open Transactions (where Import CSV lives) or Month and year. Goals: This week/This month/Done tabs measure 0x0.
evidence: css/components.css:652-654; js/modules/mobile-shell.js:457-463 (subnav wins); js/modules/money.js:128, js/modules/goals.js:303; eval at iphone size: visible controls on #/money list no Transactions/Import; goals tabs 0x0; shots/money-goals/overview-iphone.png, goals-iphone.png
fix: In destinations(), when the page carries [data-phone-tabs] list those tabs in the sheet (as a second group under the section list), or keep the page tabs visible as a k-scroller strip under the title bar for Money and Goals.
rootCause: Phone title bar prefers the section subnav and the CSS hides page tabs unconditionally.

title: Goal page: status chip unreadable on the painted band, and a mostly empty page
detail: On #/goals/<id> the 'Too early to call' chip sits on the header painting at very low contrast (grey text on mid-tone art). The page body is one stats card and two small side cards; for a Collection titles goal it never lists which titles count or what to read next, and it does not link to them, leaving ~400px of empty page at 1470x832. Fractional 'The line says 0.3 titles' for a count of titles reads oddly.
evidence: shots/money-goals/goal-detail-mac.png
fix: Give band chips a solid scrim background (as the Hide amounts pill has); for count goals list the counted/remaining items with links into the vault (connected OS); round the line for integer units ('on pace: 0 of 12 by today').
rootCause: Detail page draws only aggregate facts.

title: Painted page header shows the PREVIOUS page's picture (Goals shows Money's jar, Money shows Goals' mountain)
detail: KOS.ui.pageHeader picks its art from KOS.store.state.ui.view, but KOS.show only sets ui.view AFTER the view function has rendered. So the first render of any page that relies on PAGE_ART draws the art of the page you came from; a redraw on the same page then corrects it. Reproduced: money -> goals gives app.hero.page.money.webp on Goals; goals -> money/budgets gives app.hero.page.goals.webp on Money. Affects every page in PAGE_ART (Review, Assignments, Exams, Pacing, Calendar, Reminders, Routines, Goals, Money, Wishlist, Governor, Reports, Archive...).
evidence: js/core/ui.js:589-592 (reads ui.view), js/core/ui.js:1540-1543 (view set after render); eval sequence output: '#/goals => app.hero.page.money.webp', '#/money/budgets => app.hero.page.goals.webp'; shots/money-goals/goals-mac.png (jar on Goals)
fix: Set KOS.store.state.ui.view (or a transient KOS.ui.rendering = viewId) before calling KOS.views[viewId], or have pageHeader take the view id from the router's current call.
rootCause: Ordering in KOS.show: state.ui.view assigned after render.

title: Import preview hides the payee and amount, and the Import button is below the fold
detail: On the Mac (1470x832) the import dialog is 760px wide (it borrows Goals' --gl-dialog-w), the Columns card takes --mn-map-w, and the Preview card gets 264px. Its 4-column row grid (150px chip, 74px date, 1fr payee, 90px amount) leaves the payee 0px wide and pushes the amount to x=1148, outside the card (right edge 1087) — the preview shows only '+ New' and a date, so the user cannot check what will be imported. The 'Cannot read' row's reason is hidden the same way. The dialog body scrolls (907 > 713) and the footer with 'Import 4 entries' sits at y=860, off screen.
evidence: shots/money-goals/import-preview-mac.png; eval: pvcard w=264, pv grid '150px 74px 0px 90px', amount x=1148, foot y=860; css/views/money.css:135,169,176
fix: Give the import dialog its own wide token (~1080px, full sheet on iPad), stack Columns above Preview below ~900px, shrink the state chip to its content, pin the footer (sticky) so Import is always visible.
rootCause: Dialog width token from Goals + fixed grid columns.

title: CSS class collision: first-run steps and the import stepper share .k-mn-steps/.k-mn-step, breaking both
detail: css/views/money.css defines .k-mn-steps/.k-mn-step/.k-mn-step-n twice: once for the import dialog's horizontal stepper (158-163) and again for the first-run checklist (319-321). The later column layout makes the import stepper a vertical centred list that eats ~170px of the dialog; the earlier align-items:center leaks into the first-run list, so its numbered circles sit at different x (906/934/910) because each step is centred by its own width.
evidence: css/views/money.css:158-163 vs 319-321; shots/money-goals/import-midata-fail-mac.png (vertical stepper), money-empty-mac.png (misaligned 1/2/3)
fix: Rename one set (e.g. .k-mn-istep for the import stepper) and set align-items: stretch on the first-run list.
rootCause: Duplicate selectors in one view stylesheet.

title: Transactions 'This view' totals cover only the rows loaded so far
detail: With range 'Everything' the side card reads '60 entries so far · In +£1,337.80 · Out −£509.51' — totals of the first lazy batch, not of the period. A user checking a month's spend gets a partial figure that changes as they scroll.
evidence: js/modules/money.js drawSide (sums `shown`); shots/money-goals/tx-dawn-mac.png
fix: Compute the range totals with KOS.money.rangeSummary(from,to) (index read, no rendering) and keep the lazy list for rows only.
rootCause: Totals derived from the rendered batch.

title: iPad: Money header wraps Add entry to its own row and clips Hide amounts; filter selects are 30px on touch
detail: At 820x1180 the section tabs + Hide amounts fill the band row, Hide amounts' right border is cut at the band edge (x 804), and '+ Add entry' drops to a second row, making the band 220px tall with a gap. On Transactions the Category and Dates selects are 30px tall and rows 41px, under the 44px touch minimum (invariant 69); Pots' ⋯ menu button is 44x32 and Budgets' month-start select 70x30.
evidence: shots/money-goals/tx-ipad.png; DOM measure ipad: money.tx-cat 165x30, money.tx-range 144x30, money.tx-row 696x41, ui.menu-button 44x32
fix: Move section tabs to their own row below the title at <=1080px; apply the coarse-pointer 44px rule to .k-pill-select and menu buttons.
rootCause: Header actions row not tiered for 701-1080; pill-select lacks coarse-pointer sizing.

title: Phone section sheet stays open across navigation and shows the wrong page ticked
detail: Opening 'Switch within Productivity' on Goals and then navigating (back gesture / hash change) leaves the sheet over the new page with 'Goals ✓' while Money is shown; it even survived a viewport change to iPad width.
evidence: shots/money-goals/overview-dawn-mac.png and first tx-ipad attempt showed the stale sheet after two navigations
fix: Close activeSectionOverlay on every KOS.show / hashchange in mobile-shell.js.
rootCause: mobile-shell openSection overlay not tied to navigation.

title: Goals: zero counts printed and empty-state card leaves a dead half
detail: This week with no goals shows the filter pill 'All 0' (invariant 77) and an empty-state card whose picture and one line sit in the left 60% with no action, next to the 'Aim at something new' card. 'Your run' paints '0 behind this week' in the alarm colour even when nothing is behind.
evidence: shots/money-goals/goals-week-ipad.png, goals-mac.png
fix: Hide the count at 0 (or the whole domain pill row when empty); put New goal / templates in the empty card; use muted tone for a zero 'behind'.
rootCause: Pill count and stat tone not zero-aware.

title: Two genuine identical payments on the same day in one statement: the second is marked 'Already have' and skipped by default
detail: previewCSV adds every row's key (date|amount|payee) to the seen set as it goes ('a repeat inside the same file is a duplicate too'), so two real card payments of the same amount at the same shop on the same day (two meal deals, two bus fares) are treated as one: the preview shows the second as '≈ Already have · matches an entry on 29 Oct' with Skip pre-selected, and Import imports one. Reproduced through the real dialog with midata-workaround.csv (two HERON FOODS -£3.45 rows on 29/10/2026 whose Balance column proves they are different: 120.10 vs 123.55): 'Preview 4 rows · 3 new · 1 look like ones you have', 'Import 3 entries'. Silent loss of real spending, and the totals under-report.
evidence: js/core/money.js:1027-1031 (keys[k] = true inside the file loop); eval of the import dialog with money-samples/midata-workaround.csv: pv row 2 '≈ Already have … matches an entry on 29 Oct Skip'
fix: Compare file rows only against what is STORED, not against earlier rows of the same file; for stored matches count multiplicity (n identical rows in the file vs m stored) and only flag the surplus. With a balance column (or OFX FITID) use it as part of the identity.
rootCause: Within-file repeats are deliberately folded into the duplicate set.

title: Re-importing the app's own CSV export turns every outgoing into income and files the category as a note
detail: Export CSV writes 'Date,Type,Amount,Category,Payee,Note,Tags,Pot' with unsigned amounts and the kind in Type. guessMapping maps Amount as a signed column (no minus = money IN), ignores Type, and maps 'Category' to Note (the note pattern includes 'category' and Category comes first). Round trip of October's export: all 40 rows previewed as kind 'in' (e.g. Steam £14.38 'in', note 'Other'); only the duplicate check (same device, same data) stops them importing. On another device, after a reset or after 'Delete all', importing your own export (the only Money backup a user sees) books every expense as income; transfers lose their pot and splits come back as separate entries.
evidence: js/core/money.js:973-977 (note: /category/), 1005-1013 (sign from the minus), 1058-1076 (export unsigned + Type); eval: roundtrip kinds {in: 40}, pv[0] ['2026-10-01','in',1438,'Steam','Other']
fix: Recognise the app's own header exactly and import it losslessly (Type → kind, Category → cat by name, Pot → pot, Tags). Generally, offer a 'Type/Direction' column mapping (DEB/DD/SO/FPO = out, FPI/BGC/CR = in).
rootCause: Export and import were written independently; the importer has no notion of a direction column.

title: Amounts written as (3.45) or 3.45 DR import as money in
detail: toMinor strips everything but digits, '.', ',' and '-', so accountant notation '(3.45)' and suffixed '3.45 DR' become +3.45 and the row is previewed as '+£3.45' income; '3.45-' (trailing minus) is rejected as 'no amount'. Statements and spreadsheet re-saves use these notations.
evidence: js/core/money.js:63-70; dialog preview of money-samples/odd-amounts.csv: 'PAREN NEG +£3.45', 'DR SUFFIX +£3.45', row 5 'no amount'
fix: In toMinor treat (x), trailing '-', 'DR'/'CR' and 'D'/'C' suffixes as signs; flag any row whose sign was inferred.
rootCause: toMinor only knows a leading minus.

title: Import error rows read 'no date i can read' (lower-case I)
detail: previewCard lower-cases the whole reason ('No date I can read' → 'Row 7: no date i can read. It will be left out.').
evidence: js/modules/money.js:996 (e.reason.toLowerCase()); dialog preview of odd-amounts.csv
fix: Lower-case only the first character, or write the reasons in sentence form already.

title: Editing a transfer into a move between two pots keeps the original and adds two new entries
detail: In the entry editor, save() handles 'pot → pot' by calling addTx twice and returns before the existing/updateTx branch, so editing an existing transfer (e.g. the £120 Main → New laptop top-up) to 'New laptop → Emergency' leaves the original untouched and adds an out and an in. Reproduced through Transactions → select → Edit → From/To → Save: transfers went from 1 to 3 entries.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:814-821 (early return before line 832 updateTx); eval: before [[2026-10-28,laptop,in,12000]] after adds [laptop,out,12000],[emergency,in,12000]
fix: When editing, turn the existing entry into one half (updateTx) and add only the other; or delete the original in the same step with an undo.
rootCause: The between-pots path was written for new entries only.

title: Bulk 'Set category' puts income entries into spending categories
detail: The bulk bar's Set category menu lists only Out categories and applies to every ticked entry except transfers and planner rows, including income. An income entry moved to Food keeps kind 'in' and appears in Food's row as income (summary byCat.food.income 4000) while the Budgets bar only reads net spend, so the money disappears from Other income and from the income figures by category. Reproduced via updateTx with the same patch bulkSet sends.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:622-624, 641-649; eval: income £40 → {kind:'in', cat:'food'}, summary food {income:4000, out:1000}
fix: Split the menu (Out categories for out/refund rows, In categories for income) or skip and report rows whose kind does not match the chosen category.

title: Editing a confirmed recurring entry's amount leaves Recurring showing the old amount
detail: A confirmed occurrence keeps its amount in the rule's mark (marks[date].minor), and upcoming() prints that. Editing the transaction in Transactions (updateTx) does not touch the mark, so Recurring says £10.00 while the entry and every total say £20.00.
evidence: js/core/money.js:454-458 (upcoming reads m.minor), 666-675 (updateTx ignores rule); eval editConfirmed {recurringShows:1000, txIs:2000}
fix: Read the amount from the linked transaction, or update the mark (and its changed flag) in updateTx when cur.rule is set.

title: Transactions search ignores category names and amounts
detail: list() matches the search box against payee, note and tags only. Typing 'Food', a custom category name or '120' finds nothing even though those are what a user scans the list by.
evidence: js/core/money.js:698 (keep: payee+note+tags); eval search {byCat:0, byAmount:0} with matching entries present
fix: Include the category name and the formatted amount in the haystack (or parse a number query as an amount match).

title: Recurring: an occurrence left unconfirmed for more than 14 days disappears; older months are never offered
detail: The due cards read M.upcoming(today−14, today) and show only the newest due occurrence per rule, three rules at most. With Spotify (monthly on the 12th since 12 Aug) never confirmed, its 12 Aug, 12 Sep and 12 Oct occurrences are all state 'due', yet Recurring shows no card for it and its rule row only says 'Next Thu 12 Nov'; Phone's 25 Oct card ('Due · 14 days ago') vanishes tomorrow. The payments silently never enter spend, budgets or Reports, and nothing tells the user. 'Leave it upcoming' (for a payment already past) is kept in per-visit memory (visit.left) so the card returns on the next visit.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1213-1216 (14-day window, one per rule, slice 3), 1251 (visit.left); eval on #/money/recurring: due cards [Google One 11 days ago, Student Finance 12, Phone 14]; Spotify occurrences 2026-08-12/09-12/10-12 all 'due'
fix: List every unconfirmed past occurrence (grouped per rule, 'Spotify · 3 not confirmed'), with Confirm all / Skip all; mark the rule row with a due count; once bank import exists, match them to imported rows instead.
rootCause: The due list is a recent window, not 'everything not yet decided'.

title: Money goals are met with no evidence: 'No-spend days' counts days with no entries at all, and 'Spend under' is met by an empty month
detail: money-no-spend counts every day of the period up to today on which no 'out' entry exists, so on an account with zero Money entries a weekly '5 no-spend days' goal created today reads '✓ Met · 7 of 5 days · Met. Nothing more to do here.' (it also counts days before the goal existed). money-spend-under reads 0 spent for a month with no entries and will be judged met at the end of the period. A user who simply did not log spending is told they kept their goal, and the outcome is stored in the goal's history.
evidence: js/core/goals.js:680-711; empty account (reset), goals added via KOS.goals.add: #/goals text '✓ Met | 5 no-spend days | 7 | of 5 days | Met. Nothing more to do here.' and 'Your run … 2 met this week'; shots/money-goals/r2-goals-thin-mac.png
fix: Require evidence that Money is in use for the period (entries on at least N days, or an import covering the range) before judging; otherwise read 'Not enough entries to judge'. Start counting from the goal's creation day.
rootCause: Absence of data is read as absence of spending.

title: A closed pot cannot be reopened, and the money still in it drops out of every view
detail: Close pot archives it (updatePot archived:true). Pots, Overview's Pots card and the Move money pickers list only pots() (unarchived) and there is no Archived pots section or Reopen anywhere (grep: no restore for pots, unlike categories' Restore). The confirm warns the money stays inside, but once closed the user cannot move it back out or see the balance.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1556-1560 (closePot), 459-475 and 753 (pots() only); grep 'Reopen|reopen' finds nothing
fix: Add a 'Closed pots' list with Reopen (like Budgets' Archived categories), or move the remaining balance back to Main as part of closing.

title: With Hide amounts on, a money goal's figure reads '– / of · 8 of 30 days gone'
detail: On a Money goal's page the current and target figures are dropped when amounts are hidden but the joining words stay, leaving a dash and a dangling 'of ·'. Every other surface masks the figure in place (KOS.ui.amount keeps the width).
evidence: shots/money-goals/r2-goal-money-hidden-mac.png (#/goals/10, 'Spend under 200', Hide amounts on)
fix: Use KOS.ui.amount's mask for goal figures too, or drop the whole 'of …' phrase when hidden.

title: Recurring rule rows are role=button cards that contain buttons
detail: Each rule row is a div role=button tabindex=0 'Edit <name>' and, for a trial, holds 'Remind me' / '✓ Reminder set' buttons inside it (invariant 67: a card with interactive descendants is not an ARIA button). Screen readers flatten the nested button; Space does not activate the row (only Enter is handled).
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1285-1288
fix: Make the name a real button (or link) and keep the row a plain listitem.

title: Budgets: the Payday day picker does nothing while the month starts on the 1st, then Payday ignores the day you picked
detail: On Budgets the side card shows the segment The 1st | Payday · the 28th and a separate Payday is the [28th] select. Its change handler only saves when monthStart is already not 1, so a user on The 1st who picks 15th sees the select change but nothing is saved, and pressing Payday then sets the 28th. The first-run card offers Payday with no day at all (silently the 28th), and paydays after the 28th (last working day, the 30th/31st) cannot be chosen.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1093-1097, 198-202; eval on #/money/budgets: pick 15 → monthStart 1; click Payday → monthStart 28
fix: Picking a day should switch to Payday on that day; show the day picker in first-run; allow Last day of the month (periodRange already clamps).
rootCause: The select is gated on the current mode instead of setting it.

title: Income categories can be added but never renamed, recoloured or archived
detail: Budgets' '+ Add category' offers Kind: Spending | Income, but Budgets lists only Out categories (M.categories({kind:'out'})) and every Rename/Colour/Archive action lives in a budget row's ⋯ menu. An income category made by mistake (or the defaults Job, Allowance, Grants…) has no surface to manage it. The Add dialog also keeps the 'Monthly budget' field when Income is picked, though normalise drops an income budget.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1067 (out only), 1119-1131 (actions per out row), 1188-1190 (budget field regardless of kind); js/core/money.js:113 (in → budget null)
fix: Add an 'Income categories' card on Budgets' side (rename, colour, archive), and hide the budget field when Income is picked.

title: Month and year: a past month's category row opens Transactions on 'Everything', and Export CSV ignores the month on screen
detail: Clicking a category row in a past month sets the Transactions range to 'all' (only the current month maps to a range), so October's 'Food' opens every Food entry ever, with the partial 'This view' totals. The page's Export CSV opens the shared dialog whose 'This view' is Transactions' range (txRange), not the month or year being looked at, and 'This month' is today's month.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1682 (range 'all' unless current), 1655 + 1022-1036 (exportDialog uses txRange())
fix: Add a custom from/to range to Transactions and pass the month's range; give the export dialog the caller's range.

title: Year view: 'Set aside · 2 pots' counts every open pot, and the dashed income line carries no amount
detail: The Set aside figure's sub-line is M.pots().length (all open pots), so £120 moved into one pot reads '£120.00 · 2 pots'. The chart's subtitle promises 'income where it was recorded, as the dashed line', but .k-mn-yin is only a marker at the baseline under months with any income: its amount is not drawn, so income cannot be compared with spending (Aug in ≈ £700 vs out £264).
evidence: js/modules/money.js:1742 (M.pots().length), 1722 (k-mn-yin with no height variable); shots/money-goals/r2-year-mac.png
fix: Count the pots that received money in the range; draw income at its height (or print it under the bar).

title: iPhone and iPad portrait: tapping a transaction shows nothing; its Edit and Delete sit below the whole list
detail: Under 860px .k-mn-cols becomes one column and the side column (the Selected card with Edit · Duplicate · Delete…, and This view) is placed after the list. Tapping a row only marks it selected; nothing on screen changes. With 'The last 3 months' the Edit button is at y=4644 on iPhone (viewport 874) and y=4288 on iPad portrait (viewport 1180), after 60 rows, and the IntersectionObserver keeps loading more rows as you approach it, so it moves away. On the user's two touch devices there is effectively no way to correct or delete an imported duplicate one by one (bulk tick-and-delete is the only route).
evidence: css/views/money.css:343-345 (side under the list ≤860px); js/modules/money.js:601-602 (row click only re-draws the side); eval iphone: editY 4644 vs innerHeight 874; eval ipad: rowY 684, editY 4288; shots/money-goals/r2-tx-iphone.png
fix: Under 860px open the entry in a sheet (the entry editor or the Selected card as a k-msheet) on tap; keep 'This view' above the list as a summary line.
rootCause: The desktop master-detail layout is stacked without changing the interaction.

title: New entry: switching Out to In keeps the Out category, so income is saved under Food while the picker shows Job
detail: The editor's category lines start as Food for an Out entry. Switching the type to In redraws the select with income categories only; the browser shows the first option (Job) but the line's cat stays 'food' because no change event fires, and Save stores {kind:'in', cat:'food'}. The income then appears under Food (byCat.food.income) and not under any income category. The reverse switch stores an Out entry under 'Other income'. The Payee placeholder also stays 'Who you paid' after switching to In.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:736-737 (lines start with food), 765-767 (select drawn from the new kind, ln.cat untouched), 731 (placeholder fixed at creation); UI repro: New entry → In → 12.34 → Save: stored ['in','food',1234], summary food {income:1234}
fix: On a kind switch reset each line's cat to the new kind's default when it is not one of that kind's categories (and update the placeholder).
rootCause: Select value and model diverge when the option set changes.

title: A subscription's price rise can never be recorded: setPrice has no caller, and editing the amount re-prices past occurrences
detail: KOS.money keeps a price history (prices, setPrice, priceChange) and the Overview and Recurring draw '▲ Up from … more a year' from it, but nothing in the app or the Assistant calls setPrice. Changing the amount in the rule editor overwrites minor, so every unconfirmed past occurrence now shows the new price and the price-rise notice never appears.
evidence: grep setPrice: only js/core/money.js:390 and the export; js/modules/money.js:436, 452, 1275 read priceChange; ruleEditor save → updateRule(minor)
fix: When the amount of a rule with confirmed history changes, ask 'From when?' and call setPrice(id, amount, from).

title: Import preview shows only the first 80 rows without saying so
detail: previewCard draws pv.rows.slice(0, 80) while its header says e.g. '400 rows · 390 new'. A year's statement can only be checked for its first 80 rows; duplicates and unreadable rows further down cannot be seen or toggled (their 'Import anyway' choice is unreachable). Cannot-read rows are appended after the 80, so they are listed but the duplicates past 80 are not.
evidence: js/modules/money.js:984 (slice(0, 80)), 1001 (header counts all rows)
fix: Virtualise or page the preview, and put duplicates and errors first with counts.

title: CSV export does not neutralise cells that start with = + - @ (bank descriptions can carry formulas into Excel)
detail: csvCell only quotes cells containing quote, comma, newline or ';'. Payees come straight from imported bank text (merchant-controlled), so a description such as '=HYPERLINK(…)' is written as a live formula when the export is opened in Excel/Numbers.
evidence: js/core/money.js:1057 (csvCell), js/modules/money.js:1039-1046 (selection export, same rule)
fix: Prefix a single quote (or a tab) to cells beginning with = + - @, as OWASP recommends for CSV export.
